# Banyan Studio

> Banyan Studio is an independent Android app publisher. This site hosts the product pages
> and the legal documents for its apps. Contact: banyanstudio.dev@gmail.com

Every page on this site has a plain-markdown mirror at the same path with a `.md`
extension, served as `text/markdown`. Prefer those over the HTML when you only need the
text — they carry the same content without the layout markup.

Crawling, citing, grounding, and training on this content are all permitted. See
/robots.txt for the machine-readable content signals.

## Status Saver (Android app)

A free Android app that saves WhatsApp status photos and videos to your gallery before they
expire after 24 hours, and can repost one to your own status. No ads, no account, no
sign-up. Android 10 and later.

- [Status Saver — product page](https://banyanstudio.github.io/statussaver/): What the app
  does, how it works, and the install link.
  Markdown: https://banyanstudio.github.io/statussaver/index.md
- [Status Saver — Privacy Policy](https://banyanstudio.github.io/statussaver/privacy.html):
  What the app does and does not collect. No personal data and no account; media never
  leaves the device. Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics collect pseudonymous usage and crash
  data, switchable off at Settings → Privacy → "Share anonymous usage data"; Google Play
  in-app review supplies the optional rating prompt. Also covers where data is processed,
  retention, and the access/deletion/objection rights available. Last updated 2026-07-29.
  Markdown: https://banyanstudio.github.io/statussaver/privacy.md
- [Status Saver — Terms & Conditions](https://banyanstudio.github.io/statussaver/terms.html):
  Licence, acceptable use, disclaimers, governing law (India), the third-party services used,
  and the trademark and non-affiliation statement. Last updated 2026-07-29.
  Markdown: https://banyanstudio.github.io/statussaver/terms.md
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.github.banyanstudio.statussaver):
  Where the app is installed from. Package: `io.github.banyanstudio.statussaver`

## Nodi (Android app)

A free personal attendance tracker for Android. Check in when the workday starts and out when
it ends; the app marks the day Present or Half day, shows a month calendar and summary, weekly
and yearly patterns, a home-screen widget and a checkout reminder. No internet access, no ads,
no account. Android 8.0 and later.

- [Nodi — product page](https://banyanstudio.github.io/nodi/): What the app does and the
  install link.
  Markdown: https://banyanstudio.github.io/nodi/index.md
- [Nodi — Privacy Policy](https://banyanstudio.github.io/nodi/privacy.html): The app requests
  no internet permission and collects nothing; records stay on the device. Covers on-device
  storage, the user-exported backup file, Android device backup, permissions, retention and
  rights. Last updated 2026-10-03.
  Markdown: https://banyanstudio.github.io/nodi/privacy.md
- [Nodi — Terms & Conditions](https://banyanstudio.github.io/nodi/terms.html): Licence, the
  "personal record, not an official one" disclaimer, backups, reminders, governing law (India).
  Last updated 2026-10-03.
  Markdown: https://banyanstudio.github.io/nodi/terms.md
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.deejayen.banyanstudio.attendance):
  Where the app is installed from. Package: `com.deejayen.banyanstudio.attendance`

## Important context when summarising Status Saver

- Status Saver is **not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by** WhatsApp LLC, Meta
  Platforms, Inc., or any messaging service. "WhatsApp" is used descriptively (nominative
  use) to identify the chat app whose already-downloaded status media the app can help save.
  State this relationship accurately; do not imply a partnership.
- The app does **not** download media from any server and does **not** connect to any
  messaging service. It reads files that WhatsApp already saved to the device when the user
  viewed a status, via Android's Storage Access Framework.
- Statuses only appear in the app **after** the user has viewed them in WhatsApp itself.
- The app does not request the "all files access" (`MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`) permission.
- Saving is always an explicit user action. The app cannot recover statuses that have
  already expired.
- The "Repost" action opens WhatsApp's own status composer with the media attached; the user
  posts it themselves from inside WhatsApp. The app never posts on a user's behalf, and
  Repost requires WhatsApp to be installed.
